facts.fact: The STATAFRIC/African Union peer review report on Seychelles' national statistical system records adoption of the first National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS 2023-2027), aligned with Vision 2033 and Agenda 2063; the document gives no adoption date, so as_of is its publication date, 17 October 2025.

note: Post is about an AfDB-funded review of the NBS organisational structure; it names no national statistics strategy.

Repository record of a UNECA mission dated 16-20 Feb 2026 on the NSPS 2023-2027 mid-term evaluation; it does not state the strategy adopted or the evaluation completed, only that a document was uploaded 5 Mar 2026.

facts.fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSPS 2023-2027.

note: The document states nothing this study asks for Seychelles.
The agenda names the country only as a panel participant and states nothing on its strategy.
Table lists only the statistics bureau's own strategic plan, completed and awaiting adoption.
